before.initiative: Understand how arrival timing affects vehicle queues under the fixed signal sequence.

proposed_after.initiative: Identify which arrival patterns just before and after the last green leave vehicles waiting, and under what conditions.
proposed_after.reason: Moving one arrival relative to green changed the eight-slot queue while the number of arrivals stayed the same.
proposed_after.next_increment: Ask operations for north- and south-arm arrival records aligned to signal phase history; check whether suitable timestamps or phase-binned counts exist.
